profiles.shortDescription: Ro-Flo Compressors manufactures rotary sliding-vane compressors for low-pressure gas service. Its official documentation covers compressor construction, operation and maintenance for industrial gas-handling applications.
fullDescription: Ro-Flo's manufacturer-owned site and operating manual document rotary sliding-vane compressors designed for continuous low-pressure gas compression. The portfolio supports industrial processes that require controlled gas movement, with official material covering installation, lubrication, operation, inspection and maintenance.

profiles.shortDescription: Robot-Coupe manufactures commercial food-preparation equipment. Its official range includes food processors, vegetable preparation machines, cutter mixers, Blixer units, immersion blenders and juice extractors.
fullDescription: Robot-Coupe's manufacturer-owned catalog presents machines for preparing, cutting, mixing and processing food in professional kitchens and food-service operations. The documented portfolio spans food processors, vegetable preparation machines, cutter mixers, Blixer units, immersion blenders, automatic sieves and juice extractors.

profiles.shortDescription: Rodriguez supplies precision bearings and linear-motion technology for industrial machinery. Its documented portfolio includes thin-section and slewing bearings, linear guides, actuators and application-specific assemblies.
fullDescription: Rodriguez's manufacturer-owned site presents components and engineered solutions for rotary and linear motion. The portfolio covers precision and thin-section bearings, slewing rings, linear guides, ball screws, actuators and customized assemblies for machinery and automation systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Röders develops high-precision machine tools and automation systems. Its machine division covers milling, jig grinding, measuring and automated production cells.
fullDescription: Röders' official company and machine pages document a German engineering business with a dedicated high-speed precision-machine division. The portfolio combines milling, jig-grinding and measuring machines with automation cells and process software for demanding manufacturing tasks.

profiles.shortDescription: ROEMHELD develops workholding, quick die-change, assembly and handling technology. Its official product structure covers hydraulic clamping elements, fixture systems, die-handling equipment and ergonomic assembly solutions.
fullDescription: ROEMHELD's manufacturer-owned product directory groups its industrial technology into workholding, quick die change, and assembly and handling. The documented range includes hydraulic clamping components and systems, magnetic and mechanical die clamping, transport equipment and ergonomic handling devices.

profiles.shortDescription: ROLEC manufactures enclosure systems for industrial electronics and control equipment. Its portfolio includes aluminium, stainless-steel, plastic and mobile control enclosures plus suspension-arm systems.
fullDescription: ROLEC's official site and product portfolio document protective housings and operator-interface systems for industrial electronics. The range includes aluminium, stainless-steel, plastic and polyester enclosures, handheld and command housings, panel enclosures and modular suspension-arm systems.

profiles.shortDescription: ROLL-RING is an EBERT brand for self-adjusting tensioning elements. Its official range covers chain and timing-belt tensioners that operate through an elastomeric rolling ring.
fullDescription: The manufacturer-owned ROLL-RING site identifies the mark with EBERT Kettenspanntechnik and documents compact, self-adjusting tensioners for chain and timing-belt drives. The product principle combines an elastomeric ring with rolling contact to maintain tension without a conventional rigid mounting arm.

profiles.shortDescription: Rollon develops linear and rotary motion components for industrial automation. Its official portfolio includes linear guides, telescopic rails, actuators, multi-axis systems, robot transfer units and ball screws.
fullDescription: Rollon's manufacturer-owned site documents motion solutions for machinery, robotics and automated handling. The product structure spans linear and curved guides, telescopic rails, cam followers, linear actuators, multi-axis systems, robot transfer units, ball screws and selected rotational components.

profiles.shortDescription: ROM develops equipment for sewer cleaning, high-pressure and vacuum work, toilet servicing and pipeline inspection. Its range includes vehicle-mounted and trailer systems for municipal and industrial service operations.
fullDescription: ROM's official company pages identify a Netherlands-based KOKS Group business founded in 1980. Its product scope covers sewer-cleaning machines, high-pressure and vacuum systems, toilet-service equipment, inspection vehicles and related tools for maintaining underground infrastructure.

profiles.officialName: ROMESS-Rogg Apparate + Electronic GmbH + Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: ROMESS develops workshop equipment for brake service, hydraulic maintenance and chassis measurement. Its official range includes brake-fluid service devices, pressure tools and diagnostic measurement systems.
fullDescription: ROMESS' manufacturer-owned site documents apparatus and electronic systems for professional vehicle and workshop service. The portfolio covers brake-fluid maintenance and bleeding equipment, hydraulic service units, pressure and leakage testing, chassis measurement and related diagnostic tools.

profiles.shortDescription: Ronzio Oleodinamica manufactures hydraulic gear components. Its official portfolio covers external gear pumps, hydraulic motors and flow dividers in aluminium and cast-iron configurations.
fullDescription: Ronzio Oleodinamica's manufacturer-owned site presents hydraulic power components for mobile and industrial systems. The documented range includes external gear pumps, reversible and unidirectional gear motors, and flow dividers offered in aluminium and cast-iron constructions.

profiles.shortDescription: ROPEX develops control technology for impulse heat-sealing processes. Its portfolio includes temperature controllers, sealing controllers, transformers, monitoring modules and sealing-system components.
fullDescription: ROPEX's official site documents electronic systems for measuring and controlling the temperature of impulse heat-sealing tools. The range combines RESISTRON and CIRUS controllers, transformers, current and voltage measurement modules, monitoring interfaces and coordinated sealing components.

profiles.shortDescription: Rosa Sistemi develops linear-motion components and systems within the Rollon and Timken organization. Its portfolio includes linear guides, linear tables, ball screws and customized multi-axis assemblies.
fullDescription: Rosa Sistemi's official site identifies the company as part of the Rollon group and documents components for guided linear movement. The range includes precision linear guides and bearings, compact linear tables, ball screws and application-specific multi-axis systems for industrial automation.

profiles.shortDescription: Rosemount is an Emerson measurement-instrumentation brand. Its portfolio covers pressure, temperature, flow and level measurement for industrial process applications.
fullDescription: Emerson's official Rosemount page documents instruments for monitoring critical process variables. The brand portfolio includes pressure transmitters, temperature sensors and transmitters, flow meters, level measurement systems, tank gauging and related process instrumentation.

profiles.shortDescription: Rosenberg develops fans, motors and air-handling equipment. Its official portfolio includes EC and AC fans, external-rotor motors, air-handling units, energy-recovery systems and air curtains.
fullDescription: Rosenberg Ventilatoren's manufacturer-owned product directory documents air-moving and ventilation technology for buildings and industrial installations. The range covers centrifugal and axial fans, EC and AC external-rotor motors, air-handling units, heat-recovery units, air curtains and associated controls.

profiles.shortDescription: Rosendahl is a Rosendahl Nextrom brand for cable, wire and shock-tube production technology. Its range includes complete production lines, individual machines and smart line-control systems.
fullDescription: Rosendahl Nextrom's official business-unit and product pages identify Rosendahl as the group's cable and wire machinery brand. The documented scope covers extrusion and production lines, single machines, crossheads and digital line controls for metal, power, data, optical and specialty cable manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: RÖSSEL-Messtechnik develops temperature sensors and associated measurement components. Its range includes thermocouples, resistance thermometers, transmitters, cables, connectors and installation accessories.
fullDescription: RÖSSEL-Messtechnik's official product overview documents equipment for industrial temperature measurement. The portfolio combines thermocouples, resistance temperature detectors, measuring inserts, transmitters, compensating and extension cables, connectors and application accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: ROSTA develops rubber-suspension and tensioning elements for industrial machinery. Its portfolio includes oscillating mounts, chain and belt tensioners, motor bases, anti-vibration mounts and elastic suspension units.
fullDescription: ROSTA's manufacturer-owned site documents elastomer-based machine components for suspension, tensioning and vibration control. The range covers oscillating conveyor mountings, self-adjusting chain and belt tensioners, motor bases, anti-vibration elements, leveling feet and modular rubber-suspension units.

profiles.shortDescription: ROTAC identifies Micromatic's rotary-actuator product line. The manufacturer documents hydraulic and pneumatic rotary actuators for compact, high-torque industrial motion.
fullDescription: Micromatic's official site and ROTAC catalog document rack-and-pinion rotary actuators engineered for controlled angular motion. Available families cover hydraulic and pneumatic operation, multiple torque ranges and application-specific mounting configurations for machinery and automation.

profiles.shortDescription: ROTAMILL engineers process systems for exhaust-air purification, energy recovery and surface treatment. Its documented capabilities also cover drying, steam and condensate systems, and sulfur-processing equipment.
fullDescription: ROTAMILL's official company site presents engineered plants for treating industrial air and heat streams. The business areas include exhaust-air purification, energy-recovery systems, surface-treatment and coating lines, drying technology, steam and condensate systems, and sulfur grinding.

profiles.shortDescription: Rotarex develops valves, regulators and systems for controlling high-pressure gases. Its portfolio covers cylinder valves, pressure regulation, specialty-gas supply, fire protection and LPG or cryogenic applications.
fullDescription: Rotarex's official company and product pages document gas-control technology from the cylinder valve to complete distribution systems. The range includes valves and regulators for industrial and specialty gases, ultra-high-purity equipment, fire-suppression components, LPG systems and cryogenic control products.

profiles.shortDescription: Rotary Power develops hydraulic motors and pumps for demanding industrial and mobile applications. Its official range includes radial-piston motors, axial-piston motors, thruster motors and chemical metering pumps.
fullDescription: Rotary Power's manufacturer-owned product directory documents hydraulic power components for high-torque drives and controlled fluid delivery. The portfolio spans radial and axial piston motors, dedicated thruster motors, and chemically compatible metering pumps for industrial equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: rothe erde develops large-diameter bearings and rotary-drive components within thyssenkrupp. Its official portfolio includes slewing bearings, slew drives, rings and industrial bearing solutions.
fullDescription: The official thyssenkrupp rothe erde product directory documents components for supporting and driving large rotating structures. The range covers ball and roller slewing bearings, complete slew drives, seamless rings and application-specific bearing engineering.

profiles.shortDescription: ROTHENBERGER develops pipe tools and machines for installation, maintenance, refrigeration and air-conditioning work. Its range covers cutting, bending, pressing, threading, inspection and cleaning equipment.
fullDescription: ROTHENBERGER's official company and product pages document hand tools and machines for plumbers, heating engineers, refrigeration technicians and industrial service teams. Product areas include pipe cutting and bending, pressing and threading, plastic-pipe welding, drain inspection and cleaning, and HVAC service equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: ROUNDO is a Faccin Group brand for metal-forming machinery. Its documented product heritage covers angle rolls, plate-bending machines and plate-straightening equipment.
fullDescription: Faccin Group's official brand and product pages identify ROUNDO as a distinct metal-forming machinery brand maintained within the group. The scope includes profile and angle rolling machines, plate-bending systems, straightening machines and upgrades for installed ROUNDO equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Roxon develops bulk-material handling systems and conveyor components. Its official scope includes overland and plant conveyors, port systems, idlers, pulleys, belt monitoring and wear products.
fullDescription: Roxon's manufacturer-owned site documents engineered conveying solutions for mines, ports, power plants and process facilities. The portfolio combines complete belt-conveyor systems with idlers, pulleys, belt-monitoring equipment, wear-protection products and maintenance services.

profiles.shortDescription: RSF Elektronik develops precision position-measurement systems. Its official portfolio includes exposed and sealed linear encoders, modular angle encoders and precision graduations.
fullDescription: RSF Elektronik's manufacturer-owned site documents optical and electronic measuring systems for machine-tool and automation feedback. The range covers exposed linear encoders, sealed linear encoders, modular angle encoders, digital readouts and customer-specific precision graduations.

profiles.shortDescription: RTA develops motion-control equipment for industrial automation. Its range includes stepper drives and motors, brushless servo systems, motion controllers, electric cylinders and related transmission components.
fullDescription: RTA's official company and product pages document electronic and electromechanical systems for controlling industrial motion. The portfolio combines stepper drives and motors, brushless servo drives, programmable motion controllers, electric cylinders, gearboxes and brakes for automated machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: Rubena manufactures rubber-based components for industrial and mobility applications. Its official portfolio includes power-transmission belts, sealing elements, air springs, anti-vibration products and engineered rubber parts.
fullDescription: Rubena's manufacturer-owned product directory documents elastomer products used in machinery, vehicles and industrial assemblies. The range covers V-belts and other drive belts, seals, air springs, vibration-control components, inflatable products, technical mouldings and rubber compounds.

profiles.shortDescription: Rubinetterie Bresciane manufactures valves and connection systems within Bonomi Group. Its portfolio includes ball and butterfly valves, balancing and control valves, fittings and press systems.
fullDescription: Rubinetterie Bresciane's official site documents flow-control and pipe-connection products for water, gas, HVAC and industrial installations. The range covers manual and actuated ball valves, butterfly valves, balancing and control valves, fittings, press systems and application-specific accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Rusch Pumpen is a Hatec Group business focused on industrial pump technology and service. Its official group profile covers pump solutions, repair, maintenance and process support.
fullDescription: Hatec Group's official company profile identifies Rusch Pumpen as its specialist business for industrial pump technology. The documented scope includes pump engineering and supply, inspection, repair, maintenance and service support for industrial applications and processes.

profiles.shortDescription: Russell Finex manufactures industrial sieving and liquid-filtration equipment. Its range includes check screeners, grading separators, self-cleaning filters and liquid-solid separation systems.
fullDescription: Russell Finex's manufacturer-owned site documents equipment for screening powders, classifying particles and removing contamination from liquids. The portfolio includes vibratory check screeners, grading sieves, self-cleaning inline filters, liquid-solid separators, ultrasonic mesh systems and powder-handling solutions.

profiles.officialName: Röchling Industrial LERIPA Papertech GmbH & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: Röchling LERIPA Papertech develops engineered-plastic components for paper-production machinery. Its documented scope covers wear and drainage parts, doctoring components, suction-box elements and sealing solutions.
fullDescription: Röchling's official paper-industry page and brochure document thermoplastic components engineered for wet-end, forming, pressing and finishing sections of paper machines. The portfolio includes drainage and suction-box elements, doctor blades and holders, wear parts, guides and application-specific machined components.

profiles.shortDescription: S+S Regeltechnik develops sensors, transmitters and controllers for building and plant automation. Its portfolio covers temperature, humidity, pressure, air quality, flow, light and motion measurement.
fullDescription: S+S Regeltechnik's manufacturer-owned site documents field devices for HVAC, room and building automation. The range includes temperature, humidity and pressure sensors, air-quality and flow instruments, light and motion sensors, room operating units, controllers and wired or wireless communication variants.

profiles.shortDescription: SACHS is a ZF brand for clutch and damping technology. Its official aftermarket portfolio includes clutches, shock absorbers, dampers, dual-mass flywheels and related driveline components.
fullDescription: ZF's official SACHS brand page documents products for transmitting and damping forces in vehicle drivetrains and chassis. The range includes clutch kits and components, dual-mass flywheels, shock absorbers, dampers and application-specific replacement parts for passenger, commercial and industrial vehicles.
